question: For the already fixed three-edge D4 chain, can any as-yet-untested in-support correction subset make genuinely new or changed second-site public charge depend on the first public record, rather than merely repeat an unchanged observable?
epistemic_role: Finite exact action-subset falsification control on one ideal operator orbit; no adaptive path search, general transition kernel, or noisy JIT inference
source_basis: Jing et al. 2025 Appendix A.2/A.4 source-local red-X and ordered post-flux projector semantics
J6L periodic incidence, J6M compact vacuum orbit, J6Q exact ordered Born projector law
J6R/J6S three-edge chain and structural repeat controls

physical_and_observation_contract.geometry: Same periodic L=2, 24 blue/green sites, 108 kagome qubits and J6M common +1 star/triangle orbit as J6S
physical_and_observation_contract.causal_order: Private physical error, exact joint first flux-free star measurement, public correction subset, exact joint residual-flux-free second measurement in the postselected first sector
physical_and_observation_contract.first_record: Only full 24-bit public flux/charge/vacuum arrays; private physical support and operator identities excluded
physical_and_observation_contract.second_record: Only full 24-bit public flux/charge/vacuum arrays; no private error relation, site partition or hidden state in the record
physical_and_observation_contract.noise: No readout noise, physical stochastic histories, or additional physical faults

competing_outcomes: At least one newly eligible second site has a changed marginal or joint new-site distribution across positive first records; this is a finite ideal-state transfer witness only.
New-site marginals are constant but a joint distribution including changed operators depends on first; this is a narrower changed-observable memory witness.
Any full-public first dependence is wholly explained by unchanged repeated operators, or no dependence occurs; the four-action matrix fails to find a new-site witness.
A branch exceeds the registered support/compute cap or fails an integrity gate; that branch is censored, not re-selected.

matrix.independent_unit: One fixed exact state and physical chain; four deterministic action conditions share it, not Monte Carlo samples
matrix.new_site_definition: Eligible for second star readout and not eligible in first readout; operator partition is private analysis metadata only
matrix.changed_site_definition: Eligible at both times but the exact dressed star operator differs after the public action
matrix.repeat_site_definition: Eligible at both times with exactly identical dressed star operator
matrix.comparison: For each action compare full public second distributions and exact projected charge distributions on new-only and new-plus-changed site sets across all four positive first public records. Report site marginals and joint support separately.

acceptance: All seven input hashes, J6L chain incidence, same four first public records and unchanged frozen caller pass.

For all four action subsets, eligible sites equal residual flux-free sites and eligible stars commute in the actual flux sector; exact first and every conditional second law are nonnegative and normalize.
Each retained positive row contains only first and second full 24-bit public flux/charge/vacuum arrays plus probabilities; private operator/site partition stays outside the public record.

Full-public, new-only and new-plus-changed exact conditional distributions are compared at fixed action across all four first outcomes, with marginal-versus-joint interpretation and no adaptive geometry choice.
If any branch exceeds four nondeterministic second sites or 60 CPU seconds, fail closed/censor without raising the bound; zero histories, schedule arms, bootstraps, decoder/risk/threshold claims.
stop_rule: Fail closed on provenance/incidence drift, noncommuting eligible projectors, negative/unnormalized mass, public/private leakage, source/caller modification or budget overrun. A null four-action result does not prove global first-record independence. Do not expand to a new path, noisy history or five-round caller under this contract.
